verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a headless path for scripted automation. API tokens created under Tools → Developer → API Tokens are explicitly meant for "customer or internal automation" and are passed as Bearer tokens to the v2 REST API. The API also supports scoped permissions, dated version pinning, cursor pagination, and an official npm SDK, all of which suit CI or scripted runs. However, nothing shows that IT-specific functions (device management, identity provisioning, inventory) are reachable through this API, and there is no CI-specific guidance or CLI. missing for 10: evidence that IT device, identity and inventory operations are exposed via the API, an official CLI or documented CI/non-interactive usage patterns, independent or hands-on corroboration.
